title: Separate CCP2 baseline and experimental evidence
description:
Scope: /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/speculation-and-futurism.md and experimental-evidence sections of /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/ccp-conformance.md. Record available dated full-band, narrowband, microfragment/FEC and LR-FHSS results from their owning agents, or explicitly state not assessed when evidence is unavailable. Preserve the accepted burst-survival objective while distinguishing independent arithmetic from radio/network measurements. Do not require optional experiments to finish, change baseline SCHC/security, reopen the source policy or invent CPU/capacity/legal claims.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: This documentation leaf can complete from the accepted policy and explicit not-assessed statuses. It has no unconditional dependency on microfrag, narrow, lrfhss or optional external filings; later evidence can update the scoped record separately.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline supported behavior and each experimental profile are visibly separate. Every affirmative experiment claim cites real matching artifacts; absent artifacts are not assessed, not passed. Correct LDRO/full-authenticated-frame/reacquisition/FEC overhead and the absence of assumed capacity multipliers are maintained in examples. Amateur and unlicensed bases do not substitute automatically and OSCORE/security is not silently disabled. Local links and claim/source checks pass even when all optional experiments remain unassessed.
